problems.explain: Break each into components: 8 at 90° is ⟨8 cos 90°, 8 sin 90°⟩ ≈ ⟨0, 8⟩; 6 at 0° is ⟨6 cos 0°, 6 sin 0°⟩ ≈ ⟨6, 0⟩. Adding, the resultant is about ⟨6, 8⟩. Its length is √(6² + 8²) ≈ 10. So it is 10.0 mph.
